title: Dr. Hari Krishna —
intro: A medical professional and spiritual teacher, Dr. Hari Krishna founded the Golden Age Spiritual Movement with a vision to make meditation accessible, practical, and free for everyone. By bridging ancient spiritual wisdom with modern scientific understanding, he guides a global community toward greater awareness, conscious living, and the vision of a Golden Age.

strengths.title: Education
strengths.body: A qualified medical doctor with an MD in Anaesthesiology, Dr. Hari Krishna brings deep insights into meditation through years of personal practice and experience. He bridges ancient spiritual wisdom with modern scientific understanding, making complex spiritual concepts simple, logical, and practical for everyone.

strengths.title: 25 Years of Meditation
strengths.body: With over 25 years of dedicated meditation practice, Dr. Hari Krishna is committed to debunking myths, raising awareness, and educating people about the true benefits of meditation. His mission is to promote inner peace, make meditation accessible to everyone, and build a supportive community where individuals can openly share their experiences, explore deeper states of consciousness, and talk about their unique meditation experiences.

strengths.title: Kundalini-Awakened Spiritual Guide
strengths.body: Drawing from his personal experiences, Dr. Hari Krishna explains Kundalini energy through a scientific and spiritual approach, exploring its potential for natural healing and inner transformation. He simplifies the process of Kundalini awakening, chakra alignment, and the deeper wisdom of the Lalitha Sahasranamam, making these ancient spiritual concepts easy for everyone to understand and explore.
